title: Writing: A Discursive Essay on Technology and the Future

writingModel.placeholder: Introduce the topic and the debate — present both sides exist
writingModel.hint: Use will / going to / expected to for your predictions

writingModel.placeholder: First position: the optimistic view of technology
Second position: the concerns and challenges
Your balanced conclusion: what needs to happen
writingModel.hint: Use "On balance…", "In order for… to succeed,", future forms

writingTemplate.prefix: The rapid development of artificial intelligence is
writingTemplate.placeholder: raising fundamental questions about the future of work and society
writingTemplate.hint: Introduce the issue without taking sides immediately

writingTemplate.placeholder: augment human capabilities / creating new opportunities for everyone

writingTemplate.suffix: , which could benefit millions of people worldwide.
writingTemplate.placeholder: transformed healthcare, education, and environmental management
writingTemplate.hint: Future perfect for milestone by a future date

writingTemplate.placeholder: the disruption will not fall equally, and many workers will be left behind

writingTemplate.suffix: are likely to be most affected.

writingTemplate.prefix: On balance, I believe that technology will
writingTemplate.placeholder: transform society for the better / governments invest in education and safety nets

items: AI is expected to create new industries and opportunities.
By 2040, renewable technology will have transformed the energy sector.
Technology is likely to augment rather than replace human capabilities.
Proponents argue that innovation will generate prosperity for all.
Advances in AI are predicted to revolutionise healthcare within a decade.
Critics point out that the benefits will not be equally distributed.
A significant risk is that displaced workers will be left behind.
There is a danger that surveillance technology will erode civil liberties.
The digital divide is likely to widen without deliberate intervention.
Regulatory capacity may not keep pace with technological development.
While AI may well transform the economy, challenges remain significant.
Technology will almost certainly change work — the question is how equitably.
It would be premature to conclude that AI will solve all our problems.
The impact is likely to be uneven across different sectors and regions.
This is not merely a technical question, but a political and moral one.
On balance, the potential benefits outweigh the risks, provided that…
In conclusion, I believe technology will be transformative — for better or worse.
The future will depend on the choices we make today about regulation and investment.
By investing in education and governance now, we can shape a more equitable future.
Technology is a tool — its impact depends entirely on how we choose to use it.

questions.text: "By 2040, AI ___ healthcare in most developed countries." (milestone)
questions.hint: "By + future time" = future perfect: will have + pp

questions.text: "AI ___ (likely / create) new jobs even as it eliminates existing ones."
"___ governments invest in retraining, many workers will be left behind." (condition)
questions.hint: "Unless" = if not — condition for something bad to happen

questions.text: "In 2035, billions of people ___ (use) AI assistants for daily tasks." (ongoing)
questions.hint: Future continuous: typical ongoing activity at a future time

questions.text: Which is the most nuanced, academically appropriate prediction?
opts: AI will definitely solve climate change.
AI is going to fix everything.
AI may well play a significant role in addressing climate challenges, though much depends on governance.
AI is about to change climate.
questions.correct: AI may well play a significant role in addressing climate challenges, though much depends on governance.
questions.hint: Hedging with "may well" + acknowledgement of uncertainty = academic style

questions.text: "Technology is expected to disrupt traditional industries" uses correct grammar.
questions.hint: "is expected to + infinitive" — correct probability expression

questions.text: "When AI ___ (become) more powerful, new ethical questions ___ (arise)."
questions.hint: Time clause: present simple; result clause: will

questions.text: "By the time adequate regulation is in place, the technology ___ on." Choose the best form.
questions.hint: "By the time" triggers future perfect: will have + pp
